articles.title: 'Ramayana' cinematographer Pankaj Kumar talks about about Sunny Deol's 'Hanuman' to be seen in the second part: 'Expectations are high'
articles.summary: Ramayana gave audiences two big surprises for the next part.
articles.body: Ramayana gave audiences two big surprises for the next part. Sunny Deol appears as Lord Hanuman in the post-credit scene, while Raghav Juyal is introduced as Meghnath, son of Ravana. While not much has been said about Juyal's role, Deol's introduction became the major talking point and raised excitement among fans.While audiences are curious about what his character will bring to the film, there is already some good news. The film's director of photography, Pankaj Kumar, recently shared that several “fabulous sequences” featuring Hanuman has been shot. He also feels that these moments will make watching the character on the big screen a great experience.Speaking with Variety India, Kumar said, “The expectations around Hanuman are immense. I know people want to see him on screen. We have already shot a lot of fabulous sequences involving Hanuman, and I can promise you that it's going to be great. It's going to be a great experience to watch him on the big screen.”Other than Meghnath and Hanuman, Ramayan part 2 will also introduce some more important characters such as Jambavan, Bali and Sugriv.Pankaj Kumar further explained that Ayodhya and Lanka were given very different looks in the film. The difference can be seen in their buildings, sets, clothes and colours. Ayodhya is shown with bright colours to give the kingdom a cheerful look. Lanka, on the other hand, has a darker style, where the team used black and gold.This change is also seen in the lighting. Kumar used darker lights and strong shadows for Lanka, while he kept Ayodhya scenes bright and clear. These choices were made from the start to make both kingdoms look different and show their unique nature on screen.Ramayana Part 1 stars Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, Sai Pallavi, Ravi Dubey, Arun Govil, Anupam Kher, Lara Dutta, Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, Kajal Aggarwal and Indira Krishnan.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Javed Akhtar hails Lord Ram and reacts to Nitesh Tiwari's 'Ramayana': 'Ram is not just a person, Ram is an ideal, a morality, Ram is a way of living; I haven’t watched the film yet'
articles.summary: Veteran lyricist and screenwriter Javed Akhtar has described Lord Ram as a figure whose values go beyond religion.
articles.body: Veteran lyricist and screenwriter Javed Akhtar has described Lord Ram as a figure whose values go beyond religion. Speaking on Tuesday, he said he has heard good reviews of Nitesh Tiwari’s ‘Ramayana: Rise of a Legend’ but has not seen it yet. He also spoke about Hindi cinema’s formulaic approach and Sonia Gandhi’s new book.Javed Akhtar has not watched ‘Ramayana’ yetJaved Akhtar was at the launch of the Indian Performing Right Society (IPRS) music creator report when he shared his views. He said his daughter, filmmaker Zoya Akhtar, has watched the film and liked it.“I haven’t watched the film yet. My daughter (Zoya) has seen it, and she has been praising it; she praises things with great difficulty. I haven’t heard her praising me yet,” Javed Akhtar told PTI.Why his lyrics connect with peopleAmong his many hit songs, ‘Pal Pal Hai Bhaari’ from the 2004 film ‘Swades’ is still widely loved. One of its famous lines is 'Mann se Raavan jo nikaale, Ram uske mann mein hai.'When asked why his words moved audiences while the music of ‘Ramayana’ did not get a similar response, he answered with confidence. “The simple explanation is that I’m a good writer; let’s start from here. So, my line touches people.”Javed Akhtar says, 'Ram is a way of life'The 81-year-old writer also explained why Ram remains relevant. He said, "Ram is not just a person; Ram is an ideal, a morality, Ram is a way of living. Ram is a certain aesthetic, certain morality. So, when you look at it and appreciate it, it will touch your heart."He said, "Many people may be angry with me, but the essence of Ram runs in the blood of every Indian, irrespective of religion. While he is sometimes personified as an individual, he is far greater than that; he is a way of life."The Nitesh Tiwari film stars Ranbir Kapoor as Ram, Yash as Ravana and Sai Pallavi as Sita.Why Hindi films stay 'generic'Asked about the shortage of literary adaptations in Hindi cinema, Javed Akhtar said makers depend on safe formulas.“Earlier also, there used to be very low adaptation of literature into films. We’ve had ‘Devdas’, ‘Saheb Biwi Aur Ghulam’, and a few films; the rest were generic. Hindi movies are generic because they want to please everybody; they want people in Gujarat, Punjab, Karnataka and UP to like them,” he said.Citing his book ‘Talking Films’, he said Hindi cinema has built a culture of its own, far from real life.“I have mentioned in the book that we have a culture of states (in our country), and there is one more state, which is Hindi film. It is a state with its own culture and different architecture,” he said.“Like, I grew up in Lucknow, and I’ve never seen anyone in my life who calls his father ‘Abba Huzoor’. This happens only in films,” he added.About 'Ramayana'Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the film features Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, Sai Pallavi, Ravie Dubey, and more. The movie was released in theatres on November 5, 2026.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. Download the TOI app.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ box office collections Day 1: Advance booking for Robert Downey Jr and Chris Evans starrer crosses Rs 10 crore in India; tickets sell for over Rs 4,000
articles.summary: Marvel Studios’ ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ is off to a strong start at the Indian box office.
articles.body: Marvel Studios’ ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ is off to a strong start at the Indian box office. The film that opened advance bookings in India on Tuesday, has reportedly shot past the Rs 10 crore mark in opening-day pre-sales.As per box office tracking reports, the film has hit the milestone around 30 days before its theatrical release. Sacnilk reports that the film has sold approximately one lakh tickets across the national multiplex chains of PVR INOX and Cinepolis in just 19 hours since bookings opened.‘Avengers: Doomsday’ advance bookingsThe film’s opening-day pre-sales have already shot past the 24-hour advance collections of previous films like ‘Avengers: Endgame’ (2019), which earned Rs 8.27 crore, ‘Spider-Man: No Way Home’ (2021), which recorded an estimated Rs 6.56 crore and ‘Avengers: Infinity War’ (2018), which raked in an estimated Rs 5.02 crore.While ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ has made an impressive start, its advance bookings opened a full month before its release, thus giving it potential to grow in the weeks ahead. Meanwhile, previous Marvel blockbusters generally began selling tickets just a week before their theatrical debut.'Avengers: Doomsday' to cross ‘Avengers: Endgame’ record‘Avengers: Endgame’ also remains a major benchmark for the franchise in India. The film sold more than one million tickets on BookMyShow within its first 24 hours in 2019. ‘Doomsday’ has not reached that figure, but its early booking window has given fans considerably more time to secure tickets.‘Avengers: Doomsday’ records premium ticket pricesThe film's high ticket prices, estimated at Rs 4,200 at Cinepolis Seawoods in Nerul, has not hampered advance sales. The ticket is for a 4DX 3D screening scheduled shortly after midnight on opening day, with booking charges reportedly taking the final checkout amount to approximately Rs 4,300. The reported rate has exceeded premium ticket prices of recent releases, including ‘Ramayana’, ‘Oppenheimer’ and ‘Dhurandhar: The Revenge’.Expectations for have also reportedly been fuelled by the success of ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ earlier this year which not only crossed the Rs 500 crore mark in India, but also went on to hit the USD 2.5 billion mark at the worldwide box office. Robert Downey Jr.’s return to the franchise, this time as Doctor Doom, is another major draw for audiences.With a month still to go before its December 17 theatrical release, ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ advance bookings will now depend on whether the movie can sustain over the coming weeks.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Anne Hathaway Welcomes Baby No. 3 with Husband Adam Shulman
articles.summary: The married couple is already parents to sons Jack and Jonathan
articles.body:
Anne Hathaway is officially a mom of three!

The Devil Wears Prada 2 star welcomed her third baby with husband Adam Shulman

The married couple tied the knot in 2012

PEOPLE can confirm that The Devil Wears Prada 2 star, 43, welcomed her third baby with husband Adam Shulman .

The couple's new addition joins sons Jonathan, 10, and Jack, 6 .

The Mother Mary star first shared the exciting news that she was expecting her third baby on Friday, June 19. In a video on her Instagram , Hathaway could be seen wearing a flowy white dress as she walked into the frame with her arms in front of her stomach.

As the song "Baby I'm Yours" by Barbara Lewis played, Hathaway dropped her arms to reveal her growing bump. She smiled, hugged her stomach and ran out of frame. "x Baby, I'm yours x," she captioned the post.

A rep for Hathaway didn't immediately respond to PEOPLE's request for comment at the time.

In October, the Verity actress appeared on CBS Mornings and chatted about the psychological thriller and how she felt to be weeks away from adding another baby to her family.

"We're thrilled, we're overjoyed, but what we're really focused on right now is really taking in still being a family of four," said Hathaway.

"Because everything's going to change for us, but it's really going to change for our kids. And we're about to go through this beautiful threshold together," she continued. "So I'm just really like, soaking in what it's like to be in this unit — because my kids are older, you know? They're 10 and almost 7, so we've been this unit for a period of time. And touch wood, everything goes well with this one, that's going to change."

Never miss a story — sign up for PEOPLE's free daily newsletter to stay up-to-date on the best of what PEOPLE has to offer, from celebrity news to compelling human interest stories.

Hathaway kept her most recent pregnancy under wraps throughout an international promotional tour for the long-awaited The Devil Wears Prada sequel. An exclusive source shared with PEOPLE that she waited to disclose the news because she "was excited about the movie and wanted the attention to stay on the project," as well as to "reveal the pregnancy on her own terms."

After officially announcing the news, Hathaway appeared on Late Night with Seth Meyers and raved about how "amazing" her pregnancy had been so far. Hathaway also admitted that she was "shocked" to learn she was pregnant again.

"Oh, my gosh. It's amazing. It's amazing," she told host Seth Meyers of her pregnancy. "I mean, we knew what we were doing, but we were so shocked it worked."

"We were so shocked it went this way, so we're calling this one our buzzer-beater," Hathaway added with a laugh.

articles.title: Alaíde Costa canta Fátima Guedes, Zé Renato, Joyce Moreno e Johnny Alf no álbum 'Meu vício na dor de amar demais'  | G1
articles.standfirst: Veja a capa do disco que será lançado em 27 de novembro com repertório inédito feito para a artista.
articles.summary: Veja a capa do disco que será lançado em 27 de novembro com repertório inédito feito para a artista.
articles.body:
Capa do álbum 'Meu vício na dor de amar demais', de Alaíde Costa — Foto: Fábio Audi / Divulgação

♬ Idealizada por Marcus Preto, a capa do álbum que Alaíde Costa lançará em 27 de novembro, “Meu vício na dor de amar demais”, expõe a cantora em bela e expressiva foto de Fábio Audi.

Terceiro título da trilogia idealizada por Emicida e Preto para Alaíde Costa, o sucessor dos álbuns “O que meus calos dizem sobre mim” (2022) e “E o tempo agora quer voar” (2024) será lançado onze dias antes do 91º aniversário da artista, nascida em 8 de dezembro de 1935.

O álbum “Meu vício na dor de amar demais” foi gravado pela cantora entre fevereiro e agosto no estúdio Da Pá Virada, em São Paulo (SP), com produção de Pupillo e dos dois criadores da tríade fonográfica.

O repertório é quase inteiramente inédito e composto para Alaíde Costa, mas inclui regravação de “Ilusão à toa” (1961), uma das canções mais conhecidas do pianista e compositor Johnny Alf (19 de maio de 1929 – 4 de março de 2010), com quem Alaíde sempre teve intensa afinidade musical. A propósito, a cantora estreia amanhã, 19 de novembro, em São Paulo (SP), show inédito em que aborda o repertório de Alf com o cantor e pianista Zé Manoel.

O trio de músicos do álbum “Meu vício na dor de amar demais” é formado por Fábio Sá (baixo), Leo Mendes (violão de nylon) e pelo próprio Pupillo na bateria e na percussão. Já os arranjos de cordas são assinados por Antonio Neves e Henrique Albino – os mesmos arranjadores dos dois álbuns anteriores da trilogia.

Com essa moldura instrumental, Alaíde Costa deu voz a dez músicas inéditas. Joyce Moreno é nome recorrente nesse repertório, assinando “Meu ofício” com Paulo César Pinheiro e “Distância” e “Calos, rugas” – música caracterizada como vinheta na costura do álbum – com Emicida.

Fátima Guedes – cantora e compositora com quem Alaíde já fez show eternizado em álbum ao vivo editado em 2011 – é a autora da canção “Solar”. Zé Renato e Chico César são os compositores parceiros de “Permanecer”.

“Pó de vidro” é composição do violonista João Camarero com letra de Paulo César Pinheiro. Já o samba-canção “A falta que não me faz” traz a assinatura de Adriana Calcanhotto.

Também compositora, a própria Alaíde Costa é a autora de duas músicas do álbum. “De repente” é composição da artista com Paulo César Ventura. Já “Só por isso eu vim” – faixa já adiantada em 6 de novembro como primeiro single do álbum – é parceria de Alaíde com Emicida.

Por fim, a música-título do álbum “Meu vício na dor de amar demais” é composição de Guilherme Arantes que ganhou letra de Nando Reis.

Diferentemente dos dois discos anteriores da trilogia, bancados pelos dois idealizadores da trinca fonográfica da gravadora Samba Rock Discos, o álbum “Meu vício na dor de amar demais” foi viabilizado com recursos financeiros do edital Natura Musical.

articles.title: 'Scene' box office collection day 12: Suriya, Naslen starrer surpasses 'Vishwanath and Sons'; earns Rs 252.45 cr worldwide
articles.summary: Suriya and Naslen's 'Scene' has maintained its box office momentum, taking its worldwide gross collection to Rs 252.45 cr in 12 days.
articles.body: Suriya and Naslen's 'Scene' has maintained its box office momentum, taking its worldwide gross collection to Rs 252.45 cr in 12 days. The Tamil-Telugu thriller earned Rs 2.90 cr net in India on Tuesday, November 17. Its latest earnings came from 4,011 shows across both language versions. The film's cumulative domestic net collection has reached Rs 142.40 cr, while its India gross stands at Rs 165.45 cr.According to Sacnilk reports, the film collected another Rs 1 cr from overseas territories on Day 12. This pushed its international gross collection to Rs 87 cr. With the combined domestic and overseas earnings, the Suriya and Naslen starrer is now approaching the Rs 300 cr worldwide milestone. Its performance has also put it ahead of Suriya's previous release, 'Vishwanath and Sons', in the worldwide collection comparison.'Scene' maintains its second-week box office runThe film registered a 3.3% decline in India net collections compared to the previous day's earnings. The Tamil version remained the primary contributor, collecting Rs 2.05 cr through 2,781 shows. The Telugu version added Rs 85 lakh from 1,230 shows. Together, the two versions generated the day's domestic earnings.During its second week, 'Scene' accumulated Rs 30.70 cr net, with the corresponding gross reaching Rs 35.70 cr. Its opening week had delivered Rs 111.70 cr net and Rs 129.75 cr gross across seven days. The film's cumulative domestic figures have now crossed another major milestone, while its Day 12 earnings translated to an average of approximately Rs 7,230 per show.Tamil version dominates language-wise collectionsThe Tamil version continues to account for the largest share of the film's domestic business. Its cumulative India net collection has reached Rs 114.15 cr, representing 80.2% of the total. The Telugu version has contributed Rs 28.25 cr, accounting for the remaining 19.8%.The Tamil 2D version recorded an overall occupancy of 23.29% in the detailed tracking figures. Morning shows registered 16.46%, while afternoon screenings recorded 22.31%. Evening and night shows reported 26.46% and 27.92%, respectively.Meanwhile, the Telugu 2D version registered 15.19% overall occupancy. Its morning shows recorded 10%, followed by 14.36% in the afternoon, 13.73% in the evening and 15.55% at night. The broader language-wise tracking figures placed Tamil occupancy at 20% and Telugu at 19%.Tamil Nadu emerged as the largest contributor to the film's tracked state-wise gross collections. The state generated Rs 1.50 cr, accounting for 44.8% of the day's tracked gross. Andhra Pradesh and Telangana together contributed Rs 85 lakh, while Karnataka added Rs 40 lakh.Kerala generated another Rs 55 lakh, and the remaining Indian territories contributed Rs 5 lakh. Together, these markets recorded a state-wise gross of Rs 3.35 cr. The overall revenue distribution also highlights the film's overseas performance. Domestic territories account for 65.5% of the worldwide gross, while international markets contribute 34.5%.'Scene' moves ahead of 'Vishwanath and Sons'Suriya's previous film, 'Vishwanath and Sons', had recorded a worldwide gross collection of Rs 182.30 cr by its twelfth day. The film collected Rs 2.80 cr net in India on that day. The Tamil version contributed Rs 1.55 cr from 1,569 shows, while Telugu added Rs 1.25 cr through 1,285 shows.Its cumulative domestic net collection stood at Rs 105.50 cr, with the India gross reaching Rs 122.05 cr. Overseas territories contributed Rs 1.25 cr on the same day, taking the international gross to Rs 60.25 cr. The worldwide collection had reached Rs 182.30 cr.In comparison, 'Scene' has recorded a higher worldwide gross within the same period. The latest figures place Suriya's new release, directed by Jithu Madhavan, ahead of his previous film.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources. All figures are approximate unless explicitly mentioned, offering a fair representation of the movie's box office performance. These totals may change as official studio data is updated or as additional international market reports are finalized. articles.title: ‘Ramayana’ box office collection Day 13: Ranbir Kapoor and Yash starrer nears Rs 1,500 crore worldwide despite second Tuesday dip
articles.summary: ‘Ramayana: Part One’ continued its impressive run at the worldwide box office, with the Ranbir Kapoor and Yash starrer inching closer to the Rs 1,500
articles.body: ‘Ramayana: Part One’ continued its impressive run at the worldwide box office, with the Ranbir Kapoor and Yash starrer inching closer to the Rs 1,500 crore milestone.While on its record-breaking spree, the Nitesh Tiwari directorial witnessed a dip in collections on its second Tuesday (Day 13), earning an estimated Rs 28.70 crore net in India. As per a report on sacnilk, the film witnessed a decline of 10.3 per cent from Monday’s Rs 32 crore haul. However, its good overseas performance continued to its global total, which now stands at Rs 1,483.50 crore gross.Ramayana Movie Review‘Ramayana’ box office collection Day 13 collectionsAccording to the latest trade figures, the film collected Rs 28.70 crore net in India on Day 13 across 22,551 shows. The film's Hindi shows contributed the largest share, earning Rs 21 crore from 17,867 shows. The language accounted for 73.2 per cent of the film’s Day 13 domestic net collection.The remaining collections came from four other languages. Malayalam brought in Rs 2.35 crore from 1,070 shows, followed by Kannada with Rs 2.10 crore from 894 shows. Tamil contributed Rs 1.75 crore from 1,168 shows, while Telugu added Rs 1.50 crore from 1,552 shows.With this, ‘Ramayana’ has taken its total India net collection to Rs 821.30 crore, while its India gross stands at Rs 981.50 crore.Overseas, the film collected Rs 12 crore gross on its 13th day, taking its cumulative international gross to Rs 502 crore. This brings its worldwide gross collection to Rs 1,483.50 crore.‘Ramayana’ Week 1 vs Week 2 performanceThe film scored an estimated first-week collection of Rs 564.60 crore net and approximately Rs 675.05 crore gross. Now in its second week, ‘Ramayana’ has collected Rs 310.20 crore net in India so far.With its worldwide gross nearing Rs 1,500 Crore, the film is on the verge of joining an exclusive club. Once it crosses the milestone, ‘Ramayana’ will become only the fifth Indian film to achieve the feat in the fastest time.'Ramayana' overseas collectonsAccording to a report on PTI, the studio has expanded its overseas release from an initial 37 markets to 43 markets, with six additional territories opening last weekend.The film, bankrolled by Namit Malhotra's DNEG and Prime Focus Studios in association with actor Yash's Monster Mind Creations, recorded openings of USD 573,000 (Rs 5.4 crore) in Indonesia and USD 286,000 (Rs 2.7 crore) in Cambodia, which the makers said were records for an Indian film in those markets. It also registered a record opening in Mexico.Among its leading international markets, the film has earned USD 24 million (Rs 225.6 crore) in the US and Canada, USD 5.5 million (Rs 51.7 crore) in the UK, USD 4.7 million (Rs 44.2 crore) in the UAE, USD 4.2 million (Rs 39.5 crore) in Australia, USD 1.5 million (Rs 14.1 crore) in Thailand, USD 1.4 million (Rs 13.2 crore) in Malaysia and USD 1.1 million (Rs 10.3 crore) in Germany.'Ramayana' gears up for wider international releaseThe makers said the film is also gearing up for theatrical releases in China, Japan and South Korea, though dates are yet to be announced.The international rollout is planned to reach audiences in more than 130 countries and across 17 dubbed languages.'Ramayana' now the fifth highest grossing Indian filmAccording to trade tracking website, 'Ramayana' is now fifth highest grossing India film of all time.Tiwari's 'Dangal' still tops the list with its worldwide gross of Rs 2070.00 crore, followed by Aditya Dhar's 'Dhurandhar', which stands at Rs 1813.40 crore, 'Baahubali 2' with Rs 1788.00 crore and 'Pushpa 2' with Rs 1742.00 crore.‘Ramayana’ ranks No. 3 on IMDb’s Most Popular Movies chartAdding to its box office performance, ‘Ramayana’ has also secured the third spot on IMDb’s Most Popular Movies chart worldwide this week. The Nitesh Tiwari directorial is reportedly the only Indian film in the global Top 10, sharing the list with several major Hollywood releases.According to the rankings, ‘Ramayana’ is placed behind ‘You Can See Everything’ and ‘Ebenezer’, while Christopher Nolan’s ‘The Odyssey’ occupies the fourth position.Starring Ranbir Kapoor as Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana, the film was released in cinemas on November 5.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Technician of Bollywood film being shot in Sikkim dies in road accident
articles.summary: TRIGGER WARNING: This article contains mention of death.
articles.body: TRIGGER WARNING: This article contains mention of death.Gangtok, A 46-year-old technician, working on a Bollywood film, died after a truck carrying shooting equipment met with an accident in Sikkim, police said on Tuesday.The accident happened near the 5th Mile on Jawaharlal Nehru Road on Monday, when the film crew was returning from Tsomgo Lake, they said.Pintu Mondal, a light boy with Kolkata-based agency Light & Light, was part of the technical crew of Maddock Films' production 'Mission Mirchi', being shot in Sikkim from November 15 to 20, police said.Mondal was seated beside the driver, who reportedly lost control of the truck while negotiating a sharp turn around 3.30 pm, they said.Mondal sustained severe head injuries and was taken to STNM Hospital, where he died on Tuesday morning, they added.The driver also suffered critical shoulder injuries and is undergoing treatment, police said.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: 'The Odyssey' makes digital debut: How and where to watch Christopher Nolan's USD 1.8 billion epic
articles.summary: Christopher Nolan’s ‘The Odyssey’ has finally arrived on digital platforms, giving audiences the chance to watch the epic adventure at home.
articles.body: Christopher Nolan’s ‘The Odyssey’ has finally arrived on digital platforms, giving audiences the chance to watch the epic adventure at home.The film's digital debut follows its record-breaking theatrical run at the worldwide box office, raking in an estimated USD 1.8 billion. The film, which is now the highest-grossing film of the filmmaker’s career, is available to rent or purchase digitally, with physical editions including 4K Ultra HD, Blu-ray and DVD that hit shelves on November 17.'The Odyssey' comes with over 90 minutes of bonus contentAs per a report on Forbes, audiences who purchase ‘The Odyssey’ digitally will also get access to more than 90 minutes of bonus material spread across 12 behind-the-scenes featurettes. The additional content offers viewers a closer look at the making of the film and its production.The movie is available to rent or purchase through digital platforms, including Prime Video.'The Odyssey' among top movie purchases and rentals Within just a day of its digital release, the film has already made it to the top movie purchases and rentals. According to AP, the film ranked 8th on the list, behind 'Heart of the Beast', Resident Evil', 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day', 'Other Mommy', 'Primetime', 'Verity' and 'Mutiny'. The list also included 'Musk' and 'Godzilla Minus One'.‘The Odyssey’ could return to IMAX theatres in DecemberFor those who want to experience Nolan’s film on the big screen again, additional IMAX screenings are expected to take place in December. The film had reportedly seen IMAX shows sell out months in advance during its theatrical run, adding to the scale of its box-office success.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: 'He brought me back to life from the darkness of pain': Kannan Sagar meets Mammootty after heart surgery
articles.summary: Actor and mimicry artiste Kannan Sagar shared an emotional account of meeting Malayalam superstar Mammootty after recovering from a recent heart surgery.
articles.body: Actor and mimicry artiste Kannan Sagar shared an emotional account of meeting Malayalam superstar Mammootty after recovering from a recent heart surgery. The actor received financial and medical assistance for his treatment with Mammootty's support Kannan recently met the veteran star in person to express his gratitude.Sharing a video from their meeting on social media, Kannan described the experience as deeply emotional. He also recalled Mammootty's reassuring words and thanked everyone who stood by him during his health crisis.An emotional meeting with MammoottyKannan visited the shooting location of Mammootty's film 'Mela' at Panangad to meet the actor. Although he had seen Mammootty at a shooting location years ago, this was his first opportunity to meet him closely and speak with him. Kannan said he struggled to find words during the interaction and became emotional in front of the superstar.In his social media post, Kannan wrote, "Some meetings with Mammookka, who brought me back to life, and the people dear to him carry emotions deeper than words. They bring tears to your eyes. When I stood before my beloved Mammookka, who brought me back to life from the darkness of pain, my heart was overwhelmed with emotion.I visited the location of the film 'Mela' at Panangad to meet Mammookka, but I struggled to find the words. Although I had seen him at a shooting location years ago, this was the first time I got to meet him so closely and speak to him. My eyes were filled with tears."Mammootty's reassuring wordsKannan also recalled what Mammootty told him during their meeting. The superstar encouraged him to put the difficult period behind him and return to films. The words carried special meaning for Kannan, who described them as a blessing after his recovery.Recalling the moment, he wrote, "When I heard his majestic voice say, 'The pain is behind you now. You should return to films, laughing and making others laugh just like before,' it was not just a word... it was a blessing for the new life I received!"Kannan acknowledges those who stood by himThe meeting also included several people who supported Kannan during his treatment and recovery. He mentioned K.S. Prasad and his wife Geeta, who stood by him during difficult times. Dr. Pradeep, the cardiac surgeon at Rajagiri Hospital, and Dr. Vinod Thomas, Head of the Department of Cardiology, were also present.Kannan said their presence made the occasion even more special. He acknowledged the role played by actor Ramesh Pisharody, who brought his medical condition to Mammootty's attention.Expressing his gratitude, Kannan wrote, "Ramesh Pisharody, who brought my condition to Mammookka's attention; the office-bearers of the Care and Share Foundation, who coordinated my treatment; its director Robert Kurian (Jins); the MMA office-bearers who stood by me; the nurses and staff at Rajagiri Hospital; and every one of you who prayed for my recovery... I owe all of you a debt of gratitude that words cannot express.So, dear friends, I am coming back to you, to the love and laughter you have given me."Mammootty's upcoming filmMeanwhile, Mammootty is preparing for the release of his upcoming Tamil action-crime drama 'OM Chapter 1: Udhiram - The Blood Wood'. The actor plays the pivotal character Burma Karthikeyan, also known as Siya, in the film. The movie is scheduled to release in theatres on November 20.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. Download the TOI app.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: When Allu Arjun revealed that he struggled to get film offers after ‘Gangotri’ due to his looks:  'I went from 0 to -100, I was a nobody'
articles.summary: Tollywood’s Icon Star Allu Arjun is now one of the biggest pan-India stars thanks to the success of Sukumar’s ‘Pushpa’ franchise.
articles.body: Tollywood’s Icon Star Allu Arjun is now one of the biggest pan-India stars thanks to the success of Sukumar’s ‘Pushpa’ franchise. However, although coming from the illustrious Konidela-Allu family the actor once had a difficult start in the film industry. Let’s take a look back when the actor revealed he struggled to land scripts because of the way he looked.Allu Arjun struggled to get films after his debutWhile celebrating 20 years of ‘Arya’ in 2024, Allu Arjun spoke about the challenges he faced early in his career. According to a Republic TV report, the actor said that the success of his debut film ‘Gangotri’ did not help him secure the kind of projects he wanted.“Naa Gangotri cinema hit aindi. Nen ekkado chudadaniki pedda goppa ga lenu anesi naku pedda great films raledu (Gangotri was a hit but I didn’t look great, so good films didn’t come my way) The film was a blockbuster but it’s my failure as an artiste that I couldn’t make a mark. I went from 0 to -100, I was a nobody,” he said.The actor also recalled spending time around RTC Crossroads in Hyderabad, watching new film releases and listening to scripts. However, none of the stories interested him at the time.Allu Arjun joined hands with SukumarAllu Arjun's career took a turn when he met director Sukumar, who approached him with the story of ‘Arya’. Although it was Sukumar's directorial debut, Allu Arjun immediately liked the script. The actor also recalled how Chiranjeevi heard the story and later presented him with a shield when ‘Arya’ completed 125 days in theatres.Allu Arjun later reunited with Sukumar for ‘Pushpa 2: The Rule’, which became a major box-office success in 2024.Allu Arjun’s upcoming filmsNow, Allu Arjun is working with ‘Jawan’ director Atlee on a grand science-fiction film called ‘Raaka’. It features Bollywood star Deepika Padukone as the female lead, with Rashmika Mandanna also playing a key role.Allu Arjun has also signed a film with renowned filmmaker and actor Lokesh Kangaraj who is known for his massy gangster style projects. It is tentatively titled, ‘AA23’ and is in the pre-production phase.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. Download the TOI app.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: Jennifer Lopez says her four marriages were like ‘Learning the same thing over and over’ as she reflects on her split from Ben Affleck and her journey of self-discovery
articles.summary: Jennifer Lopez speaks about her mental state after her separation from the ‘Good Will Hunting’ star Ben Affleck.
articles.body: Jennifer Lopez speaks about her mental state after her separation from the ‘Good Will Hunting’ star Ben Affleck. Reflecting on her marriage, Lopez said it “was like learning the same thing over and over,” during a conversation with the SiriusXM studios. The ‘Wedding Planner’ actress has been married and divorced four times: to Ojani Noa, Cris Judd, Marc Anthony (with whom she shares 18-year-old twins Max and Emme), and most recently, Affleck.What Jennifer Lopez learned from her marriages?"It took me a minute to get it. And it’s fine,” she added about what she’s learned from past relationships. “Because I think that there was love that was involved and there was heartache and there were lessons. And you really realise it doesn’t matter what people do to you or any of that.What matters is what you’re doing in it or how you got there and figuring it out yourself. Like, it was really about figuring out myself every single time.” “You have six more fingers”, an audience shouted after Lopez talked about her getting married and divorced four times at the event. “That was the funniest thing I’ve ever heard in my life,” Lopez told SiriusXM hosts Nicole Ryan and Ryan Sampson.Jennifer Lopez reflected on her former husbandsWhile she was asked if she believes each of her ex-husbands came into her life “for a reason,” the 'On the Floor' singer reflected on lessons learned. “Having recently gone through [a divorce] a couple of years ago, it really felt like it was such a growth spurt for me,” Lopez explained.“I just delved into, like, ‘You know what? I need to figure out what I’m doing here.’ I felt like I did when the kids were born, but there’s another piece, or a few pieces, that I’m not getting. And I just haven’t got it yet. It’s okay, this is a long life.”What Jennifer Lopez’s therapist told her?She continued, “I had a therapist who told me — I was like, I just feel like, we all feel like sometimes we’re like— I’m f---ing everything up, you know? … He was like, ‘You’re so young. Just keep going. Keep discovering yourself and learn to love every part of yourself in that way. Even the parts that are the hopeless, romantic, and all of that.’”Rather than “blame that side of myself for things,” Lopez said she realised, “No, that’s the artist in me. That’s the dreamer in me. That’s the person who creates the things that I get to create. That’s the brave person who gets out in front of 50,000 people and dances around and does flips live on air.”“You have to be a little bit crazy. You know what I mean?” She laughed while saying this.The timeline of Jennifer Lopez’s marriage and separation from Ben AffleckJennifer Lopez, better known as J.Lo, is an American singer, actress, dancer, and businesswoman born on July 24, 1969, in the Bronx, New York. She first caught attention as a dancer on the TV show ‘In Living Color’ before breaking out as an actress in the 1997 biopic ‘Selena’ and building a huge music career with hits like ‘If You Had My Love’ and ‘Jenny from the Block.’She and Ben Affleck first dated in the early 2000s, then rekindled their romance in 2021, according to InStyle and married in Las Vegas on July 17, 2022, followed by a second anniversary of the traditional wedding ceremony in Georgia. They separated in late April 2024, and Lopez filed for divorce on August 20, 2024, as reported by People, exactly two years after their Georgia wedding.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Pankaj Tripathi wonders why educated women find ‘Mirzapur’s’ Kaleen Bhaiya attractive; says he is surprised by character’s female fan following
articles.summary: Actor Pankaj Tripathi, who essays the formidable Kaleen Bhaiya in the popular crime thriller series 'Mirzapur', says playing the character comes naturally
articles.body: Actor Pankaj Tripathi, who essays the formidable Kaleen Bhaiya in the popular crime thriller series 'Mirzapur', says playing the character comes naturally to him as he hails from Purvanchal and has grown up observing people with similar traits.However, what continues to surprise him is the character's female fan following. The actor says he often wonders what women, including highly educated research scholars and PhD holders, find appealing about a man who is submissive in front of his wife."There are no particular pros or cons to playing Kaleen Bhaiya. It comes very naturally to me because I belong to Purvanchal. I have seen and met people like him. As for the other characteristics that we have developed for the character, we are familiar with those as well," he told IANS.The star went on to share: "Sometimes, I tend to forget things on the sets, so Gurmmeet reminds me to remain non-committal. So, there aren't really any other pros or cons."Pankaj spoke about the "biggest advantage" of playing Kaleen bhaiyya."The biggest advantage is the popularity the character has brought me. People now recognise me as Kaleen Bhaiya, whether I am at the airport or anywhere else. What surprises me even more is the female fan following."Pankaj said: "Whenever I meet women who are fans of Kaleen Bhaiya, I wonder what they possibly find attractive in this man. He is someone who is submissive in front of his wife! And apparently, they like that about him."He said: "These are well-educated women, too. I am not talking about women from villages in UP or Bihar. They are highly educated women, research scholars and even PhD holders. I sometimes feel they have completely lost their minds!""Mirzapur: The Movie", which is releasing on Prime Video after its theatrical run, is made under the direction of Gurmmeet Singh, the film has been presented by Amazon MGM Studios, in collaboration with Excel Entertainment.Jointly backed by Ritesh Sidhwani and Farhan Akhtar under the banner of Excel Entertainment, the project has been co-produced by Kassim Jagmagia and Vishal Ramchandani.The film version of the series brought back several familiar faces in their beloved avatar, including Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal, Divyenndu, Rasika Dugal, Shweta Tripathi, Shriya Pilgaonkar, and Harshita Gaur. The cast also saw new members like Jitendra Kumar and Ravi Kishan.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. Download the TOI app.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: Did you know Dulquer Salmaan once worked at construction company in Dubai before pursuing acting; here's why he quit his job
articles.summary: Malayalam veteran Mammootty’s son Dulquer Salmaan has made quite a name for himself in the entertainment industry earning recognition across multiple
articles.body: Malayalam veteran Mammootty’s son Dulquer Salmaan has made quite a name for himself in the entertainment industry earning recognition across multiple languages. As he gears up for his upcoming Telugu inspirational drama ‘Aakasamlo Oka Tara’, let’s revisit a lesser-known chapter of his life, when he worked at a construction company before entering the world of cinema.Dulquer Salmaan worked at a construction company in DubaiIn an old interview back from 2022 with Curly Tales, Dulquer Salmaan revealed that he once worked at a construction company in Dubai before deciding to pursue his passion for films.During the chat, the ‘I’m Game’ actor spoke about his time in Dubai and his experience working at a construction company. During this period, he realised that he was not suited for a conventional 9-to-5 job. He also revealed that his fear of cameras had initially led him to choose a different career path. However, he eventually overcame that fear and decided to explore his interest in filmmaking.Dulquer moved to Mumbai to pursue actingAfter his short stint at the construction company, Dulquer Salmaan began making short films with his friends. The experience helped him understand what he wanted to do with his life.He eventually decided to leave his job in Dubai and moved to Mumbai to pursue a career in acting and films. Since then, he has spent over a decade in the entertainment industry, establishing himself as an actor across Malayalam, Tamil, Telugu and Hindi cinema.Earlier in his acting career, Dulquer Salmaan went on to feature in several popular films, including ‘Ustad Hotel’, ‘Bangalore Days’ ‘Charlie’ and many more. His most recent projects where he got spotlight include ‘Sita Ramam’ and ‘Lucky Bhaskar’.He also ventured into film production. His production banner backed ‘Lokah: Chapter 1’, which emerged as the biggest Malayalam hit of 2025 and the second-highest-grossing Malayalam film of all time.Dulquer Salmaan’s next filmDulquer Salmaan will next be seen in ‘Aakasamlo Oka Tara’, an inspirational drama directed by Pavan Sadineni. The film also stars Satvika Veeravalli and Shruti Haasan.The story follows a young woman who dreams of pursuing aerospace studies and becoming an astronaut. GV Prakash Kumar has composed the music for the film.‘Aakasamlo Oka Tara is scheduled’ to release in theatres on November 20, 2026, in multiple languages.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more.
